create_openai_client: create an OpenAI client configured to connect to a SGLang server at a custom base URL
build_chat_messages: build a chat messages list with system, user, and assistant roles for structured conversations
run_chat_completion_prefill: run a chat completion call with continue_final_message enabled to prefill the assistant response
run_chat_completion_default: run a chat completion call without continue_final_message to start a new assistant turn
extract_response_content: extract the assistant response text from a chat completion response object
